info.name: Get paginated carts with RSQL filtering

params.name: filter
params.description: RSQL query string for filtering (e.g. paymentStatus=in=(PAID,UNPAID);price>10)

params.name: size
params.description: The size of the page to be returned

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

items.docs: Retrieves paginated cart records for the current operator. Intended for cart analytics — typical use case is identifying high-value or anomalous quoting activity across customers. Supports RSQL filtering via `filter` and a free-text `search` parameter matched against cart number.

params.name: cartId
params.description: ID of the cart to retrieve

items.docs: Retrieves a specific shopping cart by its ID. Companion to the paginated cart endpoint for drilling into individual records during analytics workflows.

params.name: cartId
params.description: ID of the cart to pre-order

items.docs: Generates a bundled quote and purchasability check for a cart via the pre-order pipeline. Exposed for analytics consumers needing the quoted total alongside cart contents.

info.name: Get all carts for the operator

items.docs: Retrieves all shopping carts associated with the current operator
